image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), is perched on a thin, bare tree branch against a blurred blue sky background. The bird displays characteristic plumage with a greyish-brown head, an orange-rufous breast and flanks, and dark wings featuring distinct white wing bars and shoulder patches. Its bill is short, conical, and pale yellow-grey. The bird's posture is upright, gripping the branch with pinkish-brown legs and slender toes.
